faq.title: Before you open your first invoice.
faq.q1: Is Invoicey only for VAT payers?
faq.a1: No. It supports both VAT and non-VAT payers, the standard VAT regime, domestic reverse charge, and other Czech document requirements.
faq.q2: Can I invoice from multiple businesses?
faq.a2: Yes. Each business has its own bank, numbering series, VAT settings, logo, and contact details. Clients remain shared within a single workspace.
faq.a3: The agent doesn't assemble a PDF by guesswork. It prepares a structured draft that passes the same validation as a web-created invoice. Issuing or sending a sensitive document remains a confirmed action.
faq.a4: Yes. Bulk import accepts PDF and ISDOC. If the PDF contains an embedded ISDOC, Invoicey also reads the structured data; otherwise it preserves the original as an archive document.
faq.q5: Is Invoicey accounting or tax advice?
faq.a5: No. Invoicey helps prepare and manage documents, but responsibility for each specific business and tax case always rests with the user and their accountant or tax advisor.
faq.q6: How does bank payment matching work?
faq.a6: You connect a Fio or MONETA account with a token your bank issues in your name. Invoicey pulls incoming credits and proposes matches by variable symbol, amount, currency, and receiving account. Automatic confirmation is off by default, and even when enabled only an exact match passes — everything else waits for a person.
faq.a7: Yes. Set a cadence and day of month and Invoicey regularly prepares a draft with current issuer and client details. Nothing is issued on its own — confirmation stays with you.
faq.q8: Can I invoice in a foreign currency or in English?
faq.a8: Yes. A document can be in a currency other than CZK, with or without VAT, and each invoice's language (Czech or English) is chosen independently of the app language.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.description: Rules for using the current beta version of Invoicey and the division of responsibility between the service and the user.
terms.betaNotice: Private beta. These terms are a working version for the limited beta. Operator identification, paid plans, support level, and commercial terms will be added before public launch.
terms.s1Body: Invoicey is a tool for preparing, managing, importing, rendering, and sending invoicing documents. Some features may be available as beta, experimental, or only to selected users. The scope of the service may change during the beta.
terms.s2Body: Sign-in uses a supported OAuth provider — currently Google or GitHub. The user is responsible for securing this account and for the actions of people invited to their workspace. Access may not be shared in a way that bypasses permissions or technical limits.
terms.s3Body: Invoicey performs technical and schema-level checks but does not provide accounting, tax, or legal advice. The user is responsible for the accuracy of input data, choice of tax regime, authorization to issue a document, and its compliance with each specific business case. The user should review a document before issuing.
terms.s4Body: AI may prepare a draft or suggest a next step. Output may be incomplete or incorrect and must pass the same validation and human review as manually entered data. The user must not use automation for fraud, unauthorized issuance, or any other unlawful conduct.
terms.s5Body: The user retains rights to their data and files and grants Invoicey permission to process them solely for providing the service. The user must have the right to process personal and business data entered into the service. Important documents should also be stored in the user's own archive.
terms.s6Body: The beta is provided without guarantee of uninterrupted availability. The service may be changed, temporarily limited, or discontinued — especially for maintenance, security, or supplier changes. Where circumstances allow, significant changes will be announced in a reasonable manner.
terms.s7Body: The service may not be used to violate law, send spam, gain unauthorized access, circumvent security, distribute malicious code, or exploit the service in a way that places unreasonable load on it.
terms.s8Body: To the extent permitted by law, the beta service is not liable for indirect damage, lost profits, or consequences of decisions based on unreviewed automated output. This does not affect rights that cannot be contractually limited under applicable law.

privacy.metaDescription: How Invoicey handles personal data during the private beta.
privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.description: An overview of data Invoicey needs to operate, why it processes them, and what choices you have.
privacy.betaNotice: Private beta. Invoicey is currently provided to a limited circle of users. Full operator identification and contact details will be added before public commercial launch. Until then, use the same contact channel through which you gained access.
privacy.s1Intro: Depending on how you use Invoicey, the service may process:
privacy.s1Items: name, email, and profile picture from your Google or GitHub account;membership and role in a workspace;issuer, client, and invoice data including contacts, bank details, ICO, DIC, and line items;uploaded logo, signature, stamp, and archival invoicing files;records of sending, delivery, and status of invoicing emails;technical security logs and, if you consent, anonymous aggregate traffic measurement.
privacy.s2Intro: We use data only to the extent necessary for:
privacy.s2Items: sign-in, account management, and workspace isolation;creating, storing, rendering, importing, and sending invoices;protecting the service, diagnosing errors, and preventing abuse;fulfilling legal obligations related to accounting documents;measuring performance and traffic on the public site — only if you grant consent to the 'Anonymous measurement' category.
privacy.s3Body: Account and invoicing operations are based on performance of a service the user requested. Security and necessary operational logs are processed under a legitimate interest in secure operations. Optional measurement is based on consent, which can be changed at any time.
privacy.s4Body: Invoicey uses specialized infrastructure providers. Depending on enabled features, these include Vercel (hosting and optional measurement), Neon (database), UploadThing (files), Resend (transactional email), Google/GitHub (OAuth sign-in), and Slack/Vercel Connect for agent integration. These providers process data solely to deliver their specific function under their contractual and security terms.
privacy.s5Body: Accounting and issued documents may be subject to statutory archiving obligations and are not automatically overwritten when live data changes. Other data is retained for the duration of the active account and subsequently only as long as necessary to protect the service, resolve claims, or fulfil legal obligations. Specific retention periods will be added to this page before public launch.
privacy.s6Body: Within GDPR limits you may request access, correction, erasure, restriction of processing, portability, or raise an objection. Measurement consent can be withdrawn immediately via cookie settings. Some data from accounting documents may not be erasable if required by law.
privacy.s7Body: Application access uses OAuth without a separate Invoicey password. Working data is always queried in the context of verified workspace membership. No internet service can promise absolute security. This page will be updated when processing changes significantly, and a new update date will be published.

cookies.metaDescription: What cookies and local storage Invoicey uses and how to change your choice.
cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.description: Two clear categories. Essential technology for operation and optional anonymous measurement. No advertising cookies.
cookies.changeChoiceDescription: You can open settings any time. Revoking analytics consent takes effect immediately.
cookies.s1Body: These technologies cannot be disabled because they enable sign-in, session security, workspace isolation, and remembering your privacy choice. They include Better Auth secure cookies and the c15t-consent record, which stores your choice for up to one year. The UI may also store purely functional preferences in local storage, such as the theme.
cookies.s2Body: With your consent we load Vercel Analytics. It provides aggregate traffic and performance information for public pages. We do not use it for ad profiling or combine it with invoicing content. Without consent the analytics component is not loaded.
cookies.s3Body: Invoicey currently does not use ad networks, remarketing pixels, or cross-site tracking cookies. If this changes, this page and consent options will be updated before activation.
cookies.s4Body: You can open settings using the button above or the 'Cookie settings' link in the footer. Choosing 'Essential only' rejects or revokes measurement. Clearing site data in your browser also removes the stored choice, and we will ask again on your next visit.

Generator.faq3A: To send the PDF and to keep the invoice until you claim the workspace. We do not add you to a newsletter from this form.
Generator.faq4Q: Do I have to be a VAT payer?
Generator.faq4A: No. Leave VAT payer off if you are not registered — VAT mode hides, and lines go out without VAT. Reverse charge only appears when you are a VAT payer, and then the customer needs a DIČ.
Generator.faq5Q: Will ARES overwrite what I typed?
Generator.faq5A: ARES runs only when an IČO becomes 8 digits. The sample numbers on first load do not trigger a lookup. After a lookup you can still edit any field by hand.
Generator.faq6Q: Is the PDF the same as in the app?
Generator.faq6A: Yes. Same validator, same Classic look, ISDOC next to the PDF. Use See real PDF preview for a watermarked check; the emailed download is clean.

fio.connectDescription: Create a read-only API token in Fio Internetbanking and paste it here. Invoicey validates it against today’s statement and stores it encrypted. The selected business’s default receiving account is updated to this verified Fio account for future invoices.
fio.tokenHelp: Create a monitoring token in Internetbanking → Nastavení → API bankovnictví, with Sledování účtu only. The 64-character token starts working after about five minutes and can last up to 180 days if you enable automatic extension. We never display it again and never request write access.
fio.tokenGuide: How to create a Fio API token

moneta.connectDescription: Create a passive API token in MONETA Internet Banka and paste it here. Invoicey lists CZK accounts on the token, verifies today’s movements, and stores the token encrypted for this workspace only.
moneta.tokenPlaceholder: Read-only API token from Internet Banka
moneta.tokenHelp: Create a passive (read-only) token in Internet Banka → API tokeny. Tokens expire after up to 90 days unless renewed. History is limited to 90 days.
moneta.tokenGuide: How to create a MONETA API token
moneta.discoverHint: Prefer Discover accounts when the token covers more than one CZK account. A single CZK account connects without selection.
